_about: What each named problem in outcomes_uk.json looks like in a photo, in plain words, for the photo check (stages/problem.py). photo=false: not reliably visible on the leaves (roots, wood, or easily confused with drought), so never offered. Each source is the problem's first source in outcomes_uk.json. Written 13 Oct 2026.

allium leaf miner.signs: lines of small white dots along the leaves, leaves twisted or wavy

aphids.signs: clusters of small green, black or grey insects on shoot tips or under the leaves

basil downy mildew.signs: yellow patches between the leaf veins on top, grey-purple fuzz on the underside, leaves later turning brown or black

bay sucker.signs: thickened, curled, yellowish leaf edges, often with white waxy fluff

black spot.signs: round purple-black spots with fringed edges on the leaves, yellowing around them

blue mint beetle.signs: small shiny metallic blue-green beetles, or their dark larvae, eating the leaves

capsid bugs.signs: many small ragged holes in young leaves at the shoot tips

carrot fly.signs: reddish leaves and stunted growth; the tunnels are in the roots

celery leaf mining fly.signs: pale brown blotches where the inside of the leaf has been eaten out

coral spot.signs: small orange-pink pustules on dead twigs

cuckoo spit.signs: blobs of white frothy foam on the stems

fungus gnats.signs: tiny dark flies running over the compost or flying up when the pot is moved

grey mould.signs: fluffy grey mould growing on soft, brown, rotting leaves, stems or flowers

leaf scorch.signs: brown, crisp leaf edges and tips; looks the same as drought or wind damage

leek rust.signs: bright orange pustules on the leaves

mealybugs.signs: white, cottony, waxy clusters in leaf joints and under the leaves

mint moth.signs: small purple-and-gold moths, or caterpillars in webbed-together leaves at the shoot tips

mint rust.signs: raised orange or rust-brown powdery pustules, mostly under the leaves and on the stems; pale, twisted spring shoots

powdery mildew.signs: white or grey powdery coating on the upper leaf surface

root rot.signs: wilting in wet compost; the brown, soft roots are out of sight

rose rust.signs: bright orange pustules under the leaves, turning dark brown later in the year

rosemary beetle.signs: small metallic green-and-purple striped beetles, or grey larvae, on the shoots

rust.signs: orange, yellow or brown powdery pustules on the leaves

sage and ligurian leafhoppers.signs: fine pale speckles over the whole upper leaf, with no pustules, powder or fuzz

scale insects.signs: small brown or white flat bumps stuck along the stems and under the leaves, often with sticky leaves

slugs and snails.signs: large ragged holes in the leaves, often with silvery slime trails

spider mites.signs: fine pale mottling on the leaves and fine webbing between leaves and stems

thrips.signs: silvery-white streaks on the leaves with tiny black dots

verticillium wilt.signs: branches wilting and dying back; the dark streaks are inside the wood

vine weevil.signs: neat notches eaten from the leaf edges

whitefly.signs: tiny white flying insects under the leaves that fly up when touched
